rules.instruction: When the description says follow-on work starts only if a later event or condition occurs after the main flow: Model the follow-on work as a conditional continuation, an event subprocess, or a separate process whose start event represents that trigger; do not leave it as an unrelated detached start-to-end chain.
rules.situation: the description says follow-on work starts only if a later event or condition occurs after the main flow

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant performs an action to confirm or verify that an outcome occurred: Model the confirmation as an activity; use a catch event only when the description says the process waits for a message, signal, time, or condition.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant performs an action to confirm or verify that an outcome occurred

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly names multiple operations or specifies an activity’s object or recipient: Retain those stated details in the corresponding BPMN activity label so the label does not broaden or narrow the described work.
rules.situation: the description distinguishes activities by the object being acted on or the purpose of the action

rules.instruction: When the description lays out activities in an order, or requires several activities to finish before a later stage or process end.: Connect the activities with sequence flows that preserve the stated order; when every required activity must finish before proceeding, synchronize their paths with a parallel gateway.
rules.situation: the description states that one activity must occur before another

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning
rules.situation: the description identifies distinct activities, events, or outcomes with their own actions or meanings

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly states that a distinct activity is performed on the output or items of an earlier activity: Model the stated activity as a separate BPMN activity and preserve the described order with sequence flows.
rules.situation: the description explicitly states that a distinct activity is performed on the output or items of an earlier activity
